The '''Javin sector''', formerly part of [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]], was part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region, and the first sector of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] as one went rimward along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. The Spine cut directly through the sector, providing traffic to the nearby [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] and the neighboring [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat]] and [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sectors]]. The [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sector]] bordered to the north of Javin sector.

The sector capital was [[Javin]]. Other planets included [[Aztubek/Legends|Aztubek]], [[Kumru]], [[High Chunah]], all along the Trade Spine.<ref name="TEA" />
